purpose: Teach the active governance outcome vocabulary before the 000 demo input and manifested trajectory.

governance_outcome_examples.label: Allowed
governance_outcome_examples.meaning: The canonical governance evaluation permits the candidate to proceed to any separately required commit/consequence checks.

governance_outcome_examples.label: Denied
governance_outcome_examples.meaning: The canonical governance evaluation rejects the candidate for the evaluated boundary.

governance_outcome_examples.label: Review required
governance_outcome_examples.meaning: The canonical governance evaluation requires a separate review or approval boundary before consequential continuation.

governance_outcome_examples.label: Fail closed
governance_outcome_examples.meaning: The system cannot establish the conditions required to continue and therefore blocks consequential continuation.

notes.ordering: governance_outcome_examples are intentionally prepended before the demo input so a human or LLM learns the outcome vocabulary before reading the example transaction.
notes.scope: This dataset is for option 000 only and MUST NOT be treated as a submitted manifest, a governance decision, or execution authority.
